title: Trendy, but Are They Safe? Current Popular Diets and Their Use in Inflammatory Bowel Diseases: Narrative Review.
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) arises from the interplay between genetic susceptibility, immune dysregulation, microbiota, and environmental exposures, with diet potentially contributing to both pathogenesis and management.
